activity_summary: You stood at the tiring-house door for Phillips's jig of the slippers. Kemp had the stage for a quarter of an hour. Arthur was the scold, Sam the prentice who stole the shoes, Phillips the cittern, and a tabor boy beside him. The yard would not let Kemp off.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Had the stage, wet through, in the yellow slippers.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Was the scold in the borrowed kirtle.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Was the prentice who stole the shoes.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the door, and did not enter the dance.

facets.activity: Stood at the tiring-house door while Kemp had the stage
